_about: Every word of interface copy, in English (en) and Hindi (hi). This file holds wording only, never facts about the centre: facts live in centre.json, sample content in sample.json. ==double equals== marks a highlighted phrase and [[double brackets]] a red-pen underline. The build fails if a Hindi page shows English, so every hi value must be filled.
